capabilities: Visualize files and tags as nodes in a 3D graph
Run tag and time-based tag queries from tag nodes
Link and review orphan files and orphan Excalidraw files
Capture graph screenshots and import node colors from themes
extras: Detailed documentation is largely in linked wiki pages and release notes rather than in the README itself.
problem: Managing a vault with many tags is hard because tag-to-file and tag-to-tag relationships are not visible in a navigable graph.
summary: 3D graph viewer that renders files and tags as nodes, with tag queries, orphan file linking, vault growth animation, and screenshot capture.
